comparison_tracks.description: Primary paired comparison of standard/core.md v0.2.0 against frozen provider-native baseline across four calibrated Nov 2026 origin: real_work OSS tasks (RW3-RW6).
Per-model delta overlay ablation testing model-specific rules from gates/model_deltas.json (including D-OPU-4 and refined D-AST-1/D-SOL-1) layered on top of standard/core.md v0.2.0 on real OSS tasks.
End-to-end comparison of standard/core.md v0.2.0 + per-model delta overlays against provider-native baseline on real OSS tasks (RW3-RW6).

limits: Four calibrated Nov 2026 public OSS origin: real_work scenarios across four permissively licensed Python repositories (urllib3, pypa/packaging, sqlparse, tomlkit); models and lineage stages are not additional independent task scenarios.

RW1 (tomlkit) and RW2 (Python-Markdown) remain preserved in benchmarks/cases/ after 3-model baseline calibration hit 6/6 (100%) baseline pass while consuming 68% of Claude Opus token spend; pilot-v0.4.0 focuses full 5-model 3-way quota on RW3-RW6 where 3-model baseline hit 6/12 (50.0%).
Preserve benchmarks/pilot.json, benchmarks/pilot-v0.3.0.json, W1-W3, and committed results/pilot-3way-v0.2.0/ & results/pilot-3way-v0.3.0/ unmodified.
Never substitute a different model without a new explicitly labelled experiment.
